# Be Fit After 60

> Small group fitness classes and personal training for adults over 60, live on Zoom and in person in Fairfield, Iowa. Coach: Joe Weaver, age 75, trained Active Aging Specialist.

- Studio: 200 S. Main St., Fairfield, Iowa 52556
- Phone: 828-964-6622 · Email: joe@befitafter60.com
- Priorities: safety first, fun second, results third. Resistance bands and bodyweight instead of free weights; special breathing technique; music from the 1950s–70s.
- Focus: strength, balance, endurance, flexibility and mobility.
- Offer: free live Zoom classes for 3 weeks for new or former clients; free 20-minute "Stronger After 60" phone call.
- Pages: [Home](https://befitafter60.com/) · [More client reviews](https://befitafter60.com/more-testimonials.html)
